import HartshorneLib.Chapter4DivisorFrameOrder
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ProjectivePullbackBasePointFree
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ProjectivePullbackTangentCoordinates

/-!
# Tangent sections from pulled projective coordinates

A pulled linear form with irreducible chart germ gives a global section of
`O(D - x)` with nonzero fiber at `x`. The actual pulled coordinate frame and
its denominator section supply the frame normalization and order comparison
in the tangent direction of Hartshorne IV.3.1.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Opposite TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [IsProper X.hom]
variable {n : ℕ}

attribute [local instance] MvPolynomial.gradedAlgebra

/-- An irreducible coefficient of a pulled linear form gives a section
realizing the divisor bound after removing the point once. The frame and
nonvanishing denominator are constructed from the pullback isomorphism. -/
theorem exists_tangent_order_witness_of_irreducible_pulledLinearForm
    (D : CurveDivisor k X) (f : X.left ⟶ projectiveSpace k n)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj
      (ProjectiveTwist.twistingSheafOne (k := k) (J := Fin (n + 1))) ≅ divisorModule D)
    (x : NonGenericPoint X) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hi : f x.1 ∈ ProjectiveTwist.chart i) (c : Fin (n + 1) → k)
    (hc : Irreducible ((X.left.presheaf.germ
      (f ⁻¹ᵁ ProjectiveTwist.chart i) x.1 hi).hom
        (∑ j, X.left.overAlgebraMap k (f ⁻¹ᵁ ProjectiveTwist.chart i) (c j) *
          (f.appLE (ProjectiveTwist.chart i) (f ⁻¹ᵁ ProjectiveTwist.chart i)
            le_rfl).hom (ProjectiveTwist.coordinate i j)))) :
    ∃ s : divisorSections (CurveDivisor.devissageDivisor x.2 D) ⊤,
      orderAt X.hom x.2 (s : X.left.functionField) =
        divisorBound (CurveDivisor.devissageDivisor x.2 D) x.2 := by
  let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ ProjectiveTwist.chart i
  let W : LocalRatioOpen X := LocalRatioOpen.of_nonempty U ⟨x.1, hi⟩
  let s := ProjectiveTwist.coordinateLinearCombinationOfIso f e
    (fun j => X.left.overAlgebraMap k ⊤ (c j))
  let t := ProjectiveTwist.coordinateSectionOfIso f e i ⊤
  let a : Γ(X.left, U) := ∑ j, X.left.overAlgebraMap k U (c j) *
    (f.appLE (ProjectiveTwist.chart i) U le_rfl).hom (ProjectiveTwist.coordinate i j)
  let eU := ProjectiveTwist.coordinateFrameOfIso f e i U le_rfl
  have hs : (eU.hom.app ⊤).hom ((divisorModule D).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op s) =
      U.topIso.inv a := by
    rw [ProjectiveTwist.coordinateFrameOfIso_scalarLinearCombination]
    simp only [a, map_sum, map_mul]
    rfl
  have ht : (eU.hom.app ⊤).hom ((divisorModule D).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op t) =
      (1 : Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)) :=
    ProjectiveTwist.coordinateFrameOfIso_coordinateSection f e i U le_rfl
  have htx : Scheme.Modules.fiberEvaluation (divisorModule D) x.1 t ≠ 0 :=
    (ProjectiveTwist.coordinateSectionOfIso_fiber_ne_zero_iff f e x.1 i).mpr hi
  have hsorder := orderAt_eq_devissageBound_of_irreducible_frame_coefficient
    D W eU s t a hs ht x.2 hi htx hc
  refine ⟨⟨(show divisorSections D ⊤ from s : X.left.functionField),
    coe_mem_divisorSections_devissage x.2 D (by trivial)
      (show divisorSections D ⊤ from s) ?_⟩, hsorder⟩
  rw [mem_pointLattice, hsorder, divisorBound_eq_coeffAt, devissageDivisor_coeffAt]

/-- An irreducible pulled linear form supplies the repeated-point numerical
drop for the divisor system. The order witness is consumed by the intrinsic
jump criterion, so no complete-basis identification is needed here. -/
theorem h0_sub_h0_twoDevissage_eq_one_of_irreducible_pulledLinearForm
    (D : CurveDivisor k X) (f : X.left ⟶ projectiveSpace k n)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj
      (ProjectiveTwist.twistingSheafOne (k := k) (J := Fin (n + 1))) ≅ divisorModule D)
    (x : NonGenericPoint X) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hi : f x.1 ∈ ProjectiveTwist.chart i) (c : Fin (n + 1) → k)
    (hc : Irreducible ((X.left.presheaf.germ
      (f ⁻¹ᵁ ProjectiveTwist.chart i) x.1 hi).hom
        (∑ j, X.left.overAlgebraMap k (f ⁻¹ᵁ ProjectiveTwist.chart i) (c j) *
          (f.appLE (ProjectiveTwist.chart i) (f ⁻¹ᵁ ProjectiveTwist.chart i)
            le_rfl).hom (ProjectiveTwist.coordinate i j)))) :
    (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.h0
        (divisorSheaf (CurveDivisor.devissageDivisor x.2 D)) : ℤ) -
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.h0 (divisorSheaf
        (CurveDivisor.devissageDivisor x.2
          (CurveDivisor.devissageDivisor x.2 D))) = 1 := by
  apply (h0_sub_h0_devissage_eq_one_iff_exists_jumpProj_ne_zero x.2
    (CurveDivisor.devissageDivisor x.2 D)).mpr
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_tangent_order_witness_of_irreducible_pulledLinearForm
    D f e x i hi c hc
  exact ⟨s, (jumpProj_ne_zero_iff_orderAt_eq_divisorBound x.2
    (by trivial) s).mpr hs⟩

/-- Surjectivity of a projective stalk map produces the repeated-point
dimension drop through pulled chart coordinates. -/
theorem h0_sub_h0_twoDevissage_eq_one_of_projectivePullback_stalkMap_surjective
    (D : CurveDivisor k X) (f : X.left ⟶ projectiveSpace k n)
    (hf : f ≫ projectiveSpaceStructureMap k n = X.hom)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj
      (ProjectiveTwist.twistingSheafOne (k := k) (J := Fin (n + 1))) ≅ divisorModule D)
    (x : NonGenericPoint X)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (f.stalkMap x.1).hom) :
    (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.h0
        (divisorSheaf (CurveDivisor.devissageDivisor x.2 D)) : ℤ) -
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.h0 (divisorSheaf
        (CurveDivisor.devissageDivisor x.2
          (CurveDivisor.devissageDivisor x.2 D))) = 1 := by
  have hxcover : f x.1 ∈ ⨆ i, ProjectiveTwist.chart (k := k) (J := Fin (n + 1)) i := by
    rw [ProjectiveTwist.iSup_chart]
    trivial
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hxcover
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ProjectivePullback.exists_irreducible_pulledLinearForm_of_stalkMap_surjective
    f hf x i hi hsurj
  exact h0_sub_h0_twoDevissage_eq_one_of_irreducible_pulledLinearForm
    D f e x i hi c hc

end
end Hartshorne
